up: List all approved drugs that are indicated for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Include the drug's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, and indication details (mesh heading, EFO term, and the maximum phase for that indication). Only include drugs that have been approved (overall max_phase = 4). Filter the indication by the exact MeSH heading 'Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2'. Return each qualifying molecule once, with its indication details from the drug_indication table. Join molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures on appropriate keys.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    di.mesh_heading,
    di.efo_term,
    di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
  AND di.mesh_heading = 'Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2';

up: List all approved drugs that are indicated for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Join molecule_dictionary (molregno) with drug_indication (molregno) and with compound_structures (molregno) to obtain the structure. Use LEFT JOIN for compound_structures to retain drugs even if structure is missing. Return one row per drug-indication pair; if a drug has multiple indication records meeting the criteria, list each separately. Do not filter by any other conditions such as molecule max_phase or target types.
sql:
SELECT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    di.mesh_heading,
    di.efo_term,
    di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE di.mesh_heading = 'Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2'
  AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 4;
